desc: The Ganges Basin is a major part of the Ganges-Brahmaputra-Meghna basin draining 1,999,000 square kilometres in Tibet, Nepal, India and Bangladesh. To the north, the Himalaya or lower parallel ranges beyond form the Ganges-Brahmaputra divide. On the west the Ganges Basin borders the Indus basin and then the Aravalli ridge.
fact: The basin has a population of more than 500 million, making it the most populated river basin in the world · To the north, the Himalaya or lower parallel ranges beyond form the Ganges-Brahmaputra divide · Its catchment lies in the states of Uttar Pradesh , Madhya Pradesh , Bihar , Rajasthan , West Bengal , Haryana , Himachal Pradesh , Delhi, Arunachal Pradesh , the whole of Bangladesh, Nepal and Bhutan · On the west the Ganges Basin borders the Indus basin and then the Aravalli ridge
